title: plugin-auth: a host that forwards /api/v1/auth/* to a kernel's AuthManager cannot answer GET /one-time-token/handoff — the hand-off's one implementation is not exported, and minting outside it fails closed
body:
repo:cloud#2 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BsNe2y1xsMnPE6ryfq

## 维护者速读

- 手机登录交接（`GET /api/v1/auth/one-time-token/handoff`）只由 AuthPlugin 挂在它自己的服务器上（`registerRoutes`）。cloud 托管环境的内核没有自己的 HTTP 服务器，`/api/v1/auth/*` 由宿主转发给环境内核的 AuthManager，所以这条路由在托管环境上永远是 404。
- 宿主无法自己补这条路由：令牌必须在 `one-time-token-handoff.ts` 模块内部的 challenge 作用域里生成（`withHandoffChallenge`），作用域外生成的令牌按设计无法兑换。而 `runOneTimeTokenHandoff` 和这个作用域都没有从 `@objectstack/plugin-auth` 导出。
- 请求：导出一个函数 `answerOneTimeTokenHandoff(manager, request, serving)`，AuthPlugin 自己的路由也改为调用它，两处只有一份实现。cloud 已用本地补丁在托管测试台上跑通全流程；cloud#3549 和 objectstack-ai/mobile#148 等这个导出。

Filing gate: ① a defect with a named location and a reproduction. Found by the cloud#3549 thread (seat 2 dispatch, 11-08), measured on cloud's hosted tenant-kernel rig at pin `98583cd6` (18.3.0), unchanged on main `405a78ea`.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:server` lane (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth`: `one-time-token-handoff.ts`, `auth-plugin.ts`, `index.ts`).

**Business reason:** a person on a hosted ObjectOS environment cannot get into the mobile app with Google: Google refuses the app's WebView, and the fix (objectstack-ai/mobile#148) needs the environment to offer this hand-off. Every hosted environment is served this way (one host process, up to 50 per-environment kernels, auth forwarded per request), so none can offer it, whatever its release.

**Dedupe:** searched `one-time-token` (issues and PRs) and `runOneTimeTokenHandoff` in this repo: #29714, #29736, #29997, #29971 and their PRs built the hand-off and its Console half for a server that mounts AuthPlugin's routes; none covers a host that forwards to a manager it did not mount. 0 open.

## The gap, at pin `98583cd6`, unchanged on main `405a78ea`

- `GET ${basePath}/one-time-token/handoff` is mounted in `AuthPlugin.registerAuthRoutes` (`auth-plugin.ts`, the "mobile sign-in hand-off" block), which runs only under `registerRoutes`. A per-tenant kernel built with `registerRoutes: false` (it has no `http-server`) never mounts it, and better-auth's handler does not know the path.
- The route body is `runOneTimeTokenHandoff(deps, request)` with deps read off `this.authManager`. A host could build the same deps from the tenant's manager, but `runOneTimeTokenHandoff`, `resolveHandoffSignInEntry` and `withHandoffChallenge` are not exported from the package root (`index.ts` exports none of `one-time-token-handoff.ts`), and the dist is one bundle (`splitting: false`), so there is no other way in.
- Re-implementing it in the host is not possible either, by design: `oneTimeTokenStoreHasher` keys a token by the challenge held in the module's own `AsyncLocalStorage`; a token minted outside `withHandoffChallenge` is stored under a key no redemption reaches (it fails closed, as the module docblock says).

## Measurement (cloud#3549)

cloud's real tenant kernel factory on the hosted slate, every request over HTTP through cloud's host (`AuthProxyPlugin`, which forwards `/api/v1/auth/*` to the tenant's AuthManager), `trustedAppSchemes: ['ai.objectos.mobile']` passed to the tenant's AuthPlugin:

| request | answer |
|---|---|
| hand-off, anonymous JSON probe | 404 |
| hand-off, anonymous page navigation | 404 |
| hand-off, session signed in seconds before | 404 |
| `POST /one-time-token/verify` with a bogus token | 400 `Invalid token` (the plugin is mounted) |

Then with the export below built into a local copy of plugin-auth and cloud's host calling it for the tenant's manager, all six cases of cloud's e2e pass: 401 to the probe; 302 to `/_console/login?redirect=<the hand-off>&handoff_refused_at=…` on the same host; 302 to `ai.objectos.mobile://auth/callback?token=T` for a fresh session; `T` alone and `T.<other verifier>` refused without consuming; `T.<verifier>` answers the session and its cookie once and a replay is refused; an expired token and a six-minute-old session refused; an unregistered scheme and a cross-site navigation refused with no redirect; and nothing written to stdout or stderr carries the token.

## Ask

1. `one-time-token-handoff.ts` gains, and the package root exports, one function and its two input types (the shape cloud measured):

```ts
export interface OneTimeTokenHandoffManager {
  getRegisteredAppSchemes(): string[];
  getApi(): Promise<unknown>;
  getConsoleUrl(path: string): string;
  getAuthIssuer(): string;
}
export interface OneTimeTokenHandoffServing {
  authMountPath: string;
  server: { fetch(request: Request, env?: unknown): Response | Promise<Response> };
  serverEnv?: unknown;
  onUnserved(path: string, reason: string): void;
}
export function answerOneTimeTokenHandoff(
  manager: OneTimeTokenHandoffManager,
  request: { url: string; headers: Headers; queries: Record<string, readonly string[]> },
  serving: OneTimeTokenHandoffServing,
): Promise<HandoffAnswer>;
```

   Its body is today's route body: `runOneTimeTokenHandoff` with `registeredSchemes`, `sessionCreatedAt` and `generate` read off `manager`, and `signInEntry` from `resolveHandoffSignInEntry` with `serving`. `HandoffAnswer` is exported as a type beside it.
2. `AuthPlugin`'s own mount calls `answerOneTimeTokenHandoff(this.authManager, …, { authMountPath: basePath, server: rawApp, serverEnv: c.env, onUnserved })`, so the route and every host that forwards it share one implementation; its answers do not change.
3. Tests: a Hono app that is NOT the AuthPlugin's, serving the route for an `AuthManager` it was handed, answers 401 to a probe, 302 to its own sign-in page for a navigation, and a 302 whose token redeems at `/one-time-token/verify` with the verifier, once. (The last one goes red if the function mints outside the challenge scope.) The existing hand-off tests stay as they are.
4. The ledger row for `GET /api/v1/auth/one-time-token/handoff` (`auth-route-ledger.ts`) says a host that forwards the auth routes to a manager it did not mount answers it through this export.
5. Changeset on `@objectstack/plugin-auth`: `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` (a new runtime export, nothing an author writes).

## Acceptance

- The test in Ask 3 is green, and the existing `one-time-token-handoff` suites are unchanged and green.
- `answerOneTimeTokenHandoff` is in plugin-auth's published `index.d.ts`.

## Consumer (after this ships in a pin cloud can take)

cloud#3549: cloud's tenant kernel factory passes `trustedAppSchemes` from `OS_TRUSTED_APP_SCHEMES` (default `ai.objectos.mobile` on the hosted Worker), and its host answers `GET /api/v1/auth/one-time-token/handoff` with `answerOneTimeTokenHandoff(<tenant AuthManager>, …, { authMountPath: '/api/v1/auth', server: <host app> })`. The cloud draft PR is built and measured against the shape above; it lands with the pin move that carries this.

Refs #29714, #29997, #29971, objectstack-ai/cloud#3549, objectstack-ai/mobile#148
